assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000), human skeletal muscle and subcutaneous abdominal adipose tissue biopsies (S4.3.4.2.p1, key resources table)
primary_estimand: Within-group change in skeletal muscle gene expression after vs before 8 months of intensive lifestyle therapy (ILT: dietary energy restriction plus supervised exercise training 4 x 60 min/week) in people with obesity and T2D; the same within-group change in the standard-care (SC) arm is reported alongside (S2.6.p1, FIG3). Exercise is not separable from energy restriction/weight loss in this design: the estimand is the effect of the combined lifestyle intervention.
repeated_measure_unit: participant (before and after biopsies from the same person)
inclusion: Muscle RNA-seq: SC n=6, ILT n=8 participants (FIG3); adipose: SC n=7, ILT n=10 (FIG4). 9 women + 1 man in ILT, 8 women in SC among completers (S2.1.p1).
planned_contrasts: Muscle ILT after vs before, paired (S2.6.p1, FIG3A; paper: 1,540 DEGs, Table S3)
Muscle SC after vs before, paired (S2.6.p1, FIG3A; paper: 65 DEGs, Table S2)

Adipose ILT and SC after vs before: selected-gene results only (S2.7.p1, FIG4; ECM genes SPARC, LOX, LOXL1, TNMD, PDGFA, SEMA3C down after ILT; IL6, TNF, CCL2, CCL5, CD68, CD74 unchanged); no DEG count reported
paper_method: edgeR (P value and FDR per gene) on gene counts (featureCounts); pairing in the edgeR model not stated (S4.4.p1)
normalization: CPM from featureCounts gene counts; deposited file is log-transformed (moderated) CPM (GEO data_processing)

paper_results.pathways: IPA top pathways in ILT muscle: Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Oxidative Phosphorylation, TCA Cycle II, Sirtuin Signaling, NAD Signaling (FIG3B)
